paper.title: SPICE: Self-Play In Corpus Environments Improves Reasoning
paper.central_claim: A single model self-plays as a corpus-grounded Challenger (document-based tasks at the frontier via a variance reward) and a Reasoner, and the grounding gives sustained gains on math and general reasoning across four base models.

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref not exposed to the worker in this runtime; model_type recorded as configured by controller.

evidence.quote: We optimize both roles jointly (shared weights) by maximizing expected rewards:
evidence.support_explanation: Challenger and Reasoner share one model; improvement is weight-level.

evidence.quote: which updates the LLM via DrGRPO with role-specific advantages
evidence.support_explanation: Learner updates the LLM by DrGRPO; no non-weight artifact is retained for evaluation.

evidence.quote: achieves 44.9% average performance versus 35.8% baseline performance (+9.1% absolute gain)
evidence.support_explanation: Author-reported Qwen3-4B-Base gain; four base models, math + general reasoning.

evidence.quote: we develop a self-play reinforcement learning system for finetuning LLMs
evidence.support_explanation: Fine-tuning of LLM weights is the stated purpose.

signatures.object: Weights of one LLM acting as Challenger (document-grounded task generator) and Reasoner.
signatures.information: Challenger sees a raw corpus document (Nemotron-CC-Math / NaturalReasoning) and generates a question with a document-extracted gold answer; Reasoner solves without the document.
signatures.operation: Challenger reward = Gaussian of reasoner-sample variance (peak at 50% pass rate); Reasoner reward = answer match to the document-grounded gold; DrGRPO with role-specific advantages.
signatures.conditions: Corpus documents unseen by the Reasoner; MCQ/free-form formats act as verifiers.
signatures.feedback: Document-grounded gold answers and rule-based equivalence (Math-Verify).
signatures.selection_rule_data: Validity check by format/parsability; variance reward calibrates difficulty.
signatures.failure_boundary: Greedy decoding single run; baselines re-run by authors.

gap.author_gap: Ungrounded self-play plateaus from hallucination amplification and information symmetry; ground tasks in a corpus.
gap.lineage: R-Zero, Absolute Zero, SPIRAL, corpus-mining synthetic QA.

tactic_steps_checked: generate/derive training signal from the model's own outputs and filter it: executed (see signatures)
matches.reason: Generate document-grounded training questions, gate on validity and variance, retrain; the generator is steered by learner feedback (variance).
